bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- "TeamTech Formwork Solutions Ltd is an engineering formwork solutions company headquartered in Hyderabad, India, with state-of-the-art production facilities, serving India and global markets with advanced modular steel formwork systems designed for infrastructure, residential and industrial construction projects."
- "TeamTech represents a niche but critical component of the construction value chain providing engineered systems that enable faster execution, lower lifecycle cost and higher structural precision across large-scale concrete infrastructure."
- Differentiators listed under "TeamTech's Engineered Response": "Proprietary Design Software - In-house software enables rapid formwork design and proposal generation"; "Fast Proposal Turnaround - 3 - 4 day turnaround vs typical ~15 days in the market"; "Customisation Advantage - Flexible, project-specific designs compared to standardized European systems"; "Domestic Manufacturing Advantage - Local production enabling shorter lead times and cost efficiency".
- Market opportunity framed as under-penetration: "~80% of Indian construction still relies on traditional timber formwork", against a European benchmark where "Across Germany, Austria, and Scandinavia, modular steel formwork is the standard for large infrastructure and high-rise projects".
- Customer proof points: "Trusted by leading EPC contractors across India and the UAE, including L&T Construction, Shapoorji Pallonji, Tata Projects and Trojan (Dubai)", with the fuller list adding Patel Engineering, Ashoka Builders, MFAR Constructions, Cemindia Projects, RNC Infrastructures, Ayati Constructions & Estates, Dinesh Chandra Agarwal and Lloyds Engineering and Construction.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Corporate history] "Originally established as a partnership in 2017 and subsequently corporatized, the company now operates as a public limited entity"; the covering letter is signed "For Teamtech Formwork Solutions Limited (Formerly Known as Teamtech Formwork Solutions Private Limited)", NSE Scrip Symbol TEAMTECH.
- [Promoters] Mr. Eldo Varghese, Chairman and Managing Director, over 25 years, previously "Founder & General Director, Paschal Formwork (India) Private Limited"; Mr. Chaitanya Prakash Kotagiri, Whole-Time Director (Operations), over 15 years, previously Paschal Formwork (India) Pvt. Ltd.; Mr. Salinraj Kunnummal, Non-Executive Director (R&D Director), over 30 years, "Managing Director, Gulf Equipment Hiring W.L.L" and earlier Technical Manager at Paschal Concrete Forms, Bahrain.
- [Industry context] Deck-cited market data: "India Construction Market $1.04T in 2024 → $2.13T by 2030 (CAGR 12.1%)"; "India Formwork CAGR Growing at 6.4% CAGR fastest among major Asian economies"; "Infra = 45% of Formwork Demand"; "Modular Cuts Construction Time by 30%"; and "Record infrastructure allocation exceeding ₹11 lakh crore".
- [Projections] The financial charts explicitly label FY27 and FY28 as "Proj." - these are company projections, not reported results, and the deck adds "Q1 revenue is ~ 18 Cr, expected to achieve the previous year's total revenue by the end of H1 FY27".
